programmes.d: A 90-year-long feud between two families, the Hicks and the Hammonds, appears to have escalated to murder.
Things take a gruesome turn when Ferrabees Circus comes to town.
Things take a gruesome turn when Ferabbees Circus comes to town bringing with it a chain of sinister clown sightings, threatening notes and deathly dangerous circus acts.
A man is killed after the winner of an urban myth competition gains a cult following, and myth becomes reality
Jeff Bowmaker runs a profitable business in Midsomer Magna, conducting spooky "ghost tours" at night, but the unpopular village librarian turns up dead.
An outcast who was acquitted of murder years previously, comes under suspicion when more murders take place.
Fletcher's Cross is preparing for the annual cricket match when the wife of a local landowner and cricket captain is murdered after taking her dog for a walk.

Barnaby and Scott follow a trail of dead people involved in the collecting of rare orchids.
Barnaby must step into the spiritual world of mediums, psychics, and occult followers to find a killer.
A visit to his convalescent aunt prompts Barnaby to investigate a series of suspicious deaths at the nursing home where she is staying.

When Emily Simpson is found dead in her house, DCI Barnaby's instincts all lead him to suspect murder.

Artist Suzie Colebrook is electrocuted by a roulette wheel shortly after discovering a break-in at her home in Luxton Deeping.
